candidate_workaround: Give the help probe zero validation credit and invoke the validator only with each real phase-local skill directory.
failure_signature: A combined skill-creator interface probe called the validator with a help-only argument, which it interpreted as a skill path and returned SKILL.md not found.
recurrence_guard: Inspect a validator's interface or call it on a disposable real package instead of assuming it implements help mode.
rollback: Give the failed attempt zero evidence credit, retain it, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Bounded same-owner recovery only; no production, empirical, professional, authority, independent-reproduction, or Stage 20 credit.
title: Recover skill validator help-mode assumption while retaining the failed witness
trigger_preconditions: The v650-v6 x2 lane encounters skill validator help-mode assumption.
